typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		client_nbr as string,
		effdate as timestamp,
		br_account_cd as string,
		iso_currency_cd as string,
		br_account_short_nm as string,
		security_adp_nbr as string,
		cusip_nbr as string,
		type_security_cd as string,
		symbol as string,
		trid as string,
		batch_cd as string,
		entry_cd as string,
		trade_dt as timestamp,
		tag_tran_cd as string,
		settlement_dt as timestamp,
		trans_type_in as string,
		qty as decimal(24,8),
		trade_price_amt as decimal(22,8),
		principal as decimal(24,8),
		net as decimal(24,8)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ToAddLoaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Entry_cd as string,
		Cusip_nbr as string,
		Client_nbr as string,
		Symbol as string,
		Type_security_cd as string,
		Tag_tran_cd as string,
		Currency_cd as string,
		Settlement_dt as string,
		Trade_dt as string,
		Trans_type_in as string,
		QTY as integer,
		Batch_cd as string,
		Effdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Account_short_nm as string,
		Net as integer,
		Account_cd as string,
		Trade_Price_amt as integer,
		Security_adp_nbr as string,
		Trid as string,
		Principal as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = ToAddLoaddate,
		Entry_cd = entry_cd,
		Cusip_nbr = cusip_nbr,
		Client_nbr = client_nbr,
		Symbol = symbol,
		Type_security_cd = type_security_cd,
		Tag_tran_cd = tag_tran_cd,
		Currency_cd = iso_currency_cd,
		Settlement_dt = settlement_dt,
		Trade_dt = trade_dt,
		Trans_type_in = trans_type_in,
		QTY = qty,
		Batch_cd = batch_cd,
		Effdate = effdate,
		Account_short_nm = br_account_short_nm,
		Net = net,
		Account_cd = br_account_cd,
		Trade_Price_amt = trade_price_amt,
		Security_adp_nbr = security_adp_nbr,
		Trid = trid,
		Principal = principal),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
